tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa re man+ta sogs rta gzungs/ bong gzungs/ phyugs gzungs bcas bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ta thā ga tā re man+ta/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa re man+ta zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ rta nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa yi/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di ni rta yi lha yin te// rta rnams kun la srung bar byed// rta la gnod pa'i gegs rnams kun// skad cig tsam gyis thal bar rlog /rta nad thams cad rab tu zhi// 'di yis bsrung bar byas na ni// rta yi tshe srog rab tu brtan// gnod byed gzhan gyis mi tshugs so// glo bur dgra yis 'phrog par dka'// rngo dang 'bras dang 'tsher langs dang*// glo dang lheng dang 'theng grum sogs// rta nad thams cad rab tu zhi// 'di nyid ma gtogs khams gsum na/ bsrung ba'i rig sngags gzhan med do// oṃ ma hā kro dha re man+ta ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ 'phags pa rta mgrin rgyal po yis// rkang bzhi'i rta rnams bskyab tu gsol// rgyal pos rta nad bsrung du gsol// oṃ pad+man+ta kri ta h+ya gri ba badz+ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa// de nas bcom ldan 'das la cang shes nyi ma'i snying pos tshigs su bcad de bstod pa/ dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po ste// lam gyi rgyal po bde mdzad pa// dgra lha'i mchog de nyi ma'i sras// gzi ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba nyam thag don slad du/ thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dren mdzad pa// lam gyi dgra dang 'jigs pa sol// khyu mchog rta rnams spel ba dang*// mnga' mdzad thub dbang lha yi lha/ phyag 'tshal gzhon nu re man+ta// gnod gyur dgra las rgyal ba dang*// lam gyi dgra dang 'jigs pa sol// nor gyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// oṃ ār+ya re man+ta ma swā hā// 'phags pa rta nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya re man+ta nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa re man+ta zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ nyi ma shar ro dpal shar ro// dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po ste// lam gyi rgyal po bde mdzad pa// dgra lha'i mchog de nyi ma'i sras// gzi ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje dbang gis mgon gyur pas// lam gyi dgra dang 'jigs pa sol// khyu mchog rta rnams spel ba dang*/

mnga' mdzod thub dbang lha yi sras/ phyag 'tshal gzhon nu re man+ta// gnod gyur dgra las rgyal ba dang*// phyogs kyi dpag tshad thams cad du// skyong zhing rta nor spel ba dang*// skyes rabs mchog la dad pa yis// re ba'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal nas// mgon po thugs rje can rnams kyis// bdag la srungs shig bskyab tu gsol// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ ha de phu ni ha de phu ni hā swā hā// lha'i bu de nyi ma'i sras/ ār+ya re man+ta zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di/ bdag lam du zhugs kar lan bdun brjod na/ rta phyugs legs shing mi dang rta phyug go /de'i rgyan dang cha lugs ni/ 'khor lnga brgyas bskor ba'i rta sngon po nywa bzhi nag po chu ris can chibs su chibs pa/ sku la bse khrab ser po gsol ba/ lcags kyi bya khra gnyis phrag pa la lding ba/ stag gnyis sngon la 'phyo ba/ seng ge gnyis rgyab nas 'gying ba/ spyi gtsug nas bya khyung gnyis lding ba/ phyag na mda' gzhu dang*/ mdung dang*/ ral gri dang*/ ba dan dang*/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pa bsnams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ tad+ya thā/ bri yi bri ya purna dz+nyā sar sti ni dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ u u ti ni swā hā/ dpal ār+ya re man+ta zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya shrī ma hā kā la dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mgon po nag po rta'i gzungs// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das snying po byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la rig pa 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ shri ma hā kā la ga ne sha ye ma ta ghi ni/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ li haḥ ke ni hi la swā hā// 'di bton pas bdag la dgyes par dgongs shig /sdang ba'i dgra thul cig /gnod pa'i gegs thul cig /rta yi nad dang gnod pa sol cig /'khor dang rta nor spel cig /bdag gi bsam pa thams cad mthar phyin par gyur cig

/bdag gi gnod pa thams cad lha mgon po nag pos thul cig /chibs su rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ nyi ma dang zla ba rgyu skar gyi 'od bzhin 'phro ba/ srin po spu rangs choms la/ lha ma yin gyi grong khyer brlag par byed pa/ rta dang mi yi skar ma ngan pa sel ba dang*/ gnod pa thams cad choms shig /lam gyi 'jigs pa thams cad sol cig /ces nangs par tho rangs khar kha ton du byas na 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo*// bcom ldan 'das la mgon po nag pos rig pa phul nas/ mi phyugs rta dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā yo gi ni/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po khams gsum la dbang sgyur ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// nor lha gnod sbyin gang ba bzang pos dpal phyag na rdo rje la gus par btud cing zhabs spyi bor blangs te/ nor rnams skyong zhing dpal bskyed par mdzad pa/ gnod sbyin gang ba bzang pos/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la rig 'dzin gsol ba 'debs pa'i sngags 'di brjod cing*/ lan gsum bskor ba byas/ thal mo sbyar gus par 'dug /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mas+t+rai lokya bhu ri bhu ri/ se ya na ta/ rta rnams la srungs shig /nor rnams spel cig swā hā// brkyang phyag 'tshal zhing gsang sngags brjod pas/ nad dang gnod pa thams cad sel lo// dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje sku gsung thugs// rta nad drag po 'dul bar mdzad pa yi// thugs dam srog snying dngos grub ster mdzad pa// byang chub gang ba bzang pos rta nor spel// rta rnams bsrung ba'i cho ga ni/ srad bu la sngags 'di btab nas mgul du btags na nad kyis mi tshugs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ bai shra ma ṇa badz+ra/ bod skad du/ rgyal po rnam thos sras kyis/ dpal phyag na rdo rje ri rab kyi zom na bzhugs pa la/ rgyal pos sprul pa sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas nas/ pus mo btsugs thal mo sbyar/

zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas nas/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la gus par mchod nas/ bstod pa dang mdo 'di rgyun du bton na/ bu dang rigs brgyud 'phel/ 'di'i snying po 'di brjod na/ bsod nams 'phel zhing rab tu brtan par 'gyur/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa badz+ra rak+ṣa/ ces dpal phyag na rdo rje bstod cing rang rtags su phul bas/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes rgyal po la bstod pa/ rgyal po byang chub gser 'dra seng ge zhon// mi 'jigs skyob phyir ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin// lha dbang skyob phyir brgya byin nyid dang bcas// rta nor spel phyir gnod sbyin tshogs dang bcas// rta nor spel zhing 'bru rnams 'phel bar mdzod// gser g.yu rin chen bang mdzod dngos grub stsol// dpal phyag na rdo rjes rgyal po la bstod pa mdzad pa rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya gho ra dha ni/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rta nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs/ rta mgrin dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di ni rta yi lha yin no// rta rnams kun la srung bar byed// me dpung 'bar ba'i gzhal yas su// rta mgrin pad+ma he ru ka /sku mdog dmar po me 'od 'phro// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis bgrad// g.yas pa rdo rje dbyug tho 'phyar// g.yon pa rdo rje lcags sgrog bsnams// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs// thugs rje khro gnyer can spyan gsum// sdang mig phyogs bcur 'phro zhing gzigs// spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang khu yi// rta skad 'tsher bas dgra bgegs 'dul// rta la gnod pa'i gegs rnams kun// skad gcig tsam gyis thal bar rlog /rta nad thams cad rab tu zhi/ 'di yis bsrung bar byas na ni// rta yi tshe srog rab tu brtan// glo bur dgra yis 'phrog par dka'// rngo dang 'bras dang 'tsher langs dang*// tsha long grang long srin 'gag dang*// lheng dang 'theng 'grum la sogs pa'i// rta nad thams cad rab tu zhi// 'di las ma gtogs khams gsum na// bsrung ba'i rig sngags gzhan med do// gzungs sngags 'di la 'bad par rigs// oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta kri ta badz+ra kro dha h+ya gri ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/

gnod byed sarba rak+ṣa/ rta la gnod byed kun tu ya swā hā/ rta rnams kyi cha dkar po shin+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ bdud yaṃ shing nag po shin+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sa'i phyogs byed nag po shin+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā// bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po yis/ mi phyugs rta dang bcas pa'i gnod pa bsrung du gsol/ ser ba bsrung du gsol/ khyad par rkang bzhi'i rta la srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ ces pas rta'i nad dang gnod pa thams cad las grol lo// gtor ma rgyan dang bcas te gnas dben par btsugs te/ chang phud gtsang ma sbran la/ nub phyogs su rta nad dbang bdag gi g.yul ngo las rgyal lo// mi phyugs rta dang bcas pa la dgra gegs kyi gnod pas mi tshugs so// gzungs sngags 'di mang du bzlas te skud pa dmar po la mdud pa bor te/ rta'i rngo la btags na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// dpal rta mgrin gyi rta'i gzungs 'di/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ lho dpal rta mgrin gling nas gter nas bton pa'o/// /rta lha'i rgyal po ār+ya re man+ta nyi ma shar phyogs kyi mgon po mi dkar po// rta dmar po la chibs pa/ phyag na ba dan dmar po bsnams pa/ sku la dung khrab dkar po gsol ba/ dbu la dung zhwa gsol ba/ khyod kyis rta 'di la srungs shig /skyobs shig /ār+ya re man+ta ghor rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ nyi ma byang gi mgon po nor lha rta bdag ku bhe ra zhes bya ba/ sku la bse khrab dang*/ dbu la gser gyi rmog zhwa gsol ba/ chibs su rta sngon po rgal nag la chibs pa/ phyag na ral gri bsnams pa/ 'khor du lha chen brgya dang bcas pa/ ba dan 'phyar ba khyed kyis rta 'di rnams la srungs shig /spel cig /rgod ma tshos cig /rti'u'i rdzi'u khyod kyis mdzod cig /gdon gegs dang srin la ma bskur cig /oṃ ku be ra ye swā hā/ gnod sbyin ku be ra zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /
